segments.oily: Reviewers with oily skin report the serum controls oil and clears breakouts without heaviness, though one review notes serums generally leave her skin oily except this one.
segments.dry: Reviewers with dry skin say it does not dry them out further and one with very dry, reactive skin saw acne reduced after a single use, though it can still sting or irritate on sensitive-dry combinations.
segments.combination: Combination-skin reviewers describe it as lightweight, non-drying and effective on breakouts even where skin swings between oily and dry patches.
segments.sensitive: Sensitive-skin reviewers are split: several say it treats blemishes without irritation or dryness and tolerate the scent fine, while others report burning, strong fragrance reaction, or new breakouts after one use, especially with eczema-prone or acid-reactive skin.
segments.mature: Reviewers in their late 30s to 50s report it controls hormonal or age-related breakouts and softens fine lines/wrinkles while keeping skin calm.

concerns.aging: Mature reviewers (40s-58) report reduced forehead wrinkles, softer lines and less noticeable aging alongside acne control; no reviewer reports the product worsening signs of aging.
concerns.dehydration: Multiple reviewers say it does not dry out skin the way other acne treatments do and even feels hydrating; one reviewer with dry, reactive skin reports visible improvement, though a couple of sensitive reviewers experienced irritation that reads as harshness rather than dryness.
concerns.redness: One reviewer reports the serum reduces redness and post-acne marks alongside smoother, clearer skin; no other redness-specific complaints appear.
concerns.barrier: One reviewer used it after damaging her skin barrier and found it gentle and clearing; another with sensitive/reactive skin says it helped barrier quality and texture, but a couple of very sensitive/eczema-prone users reported the opposite, with burning and new breakouts.
concerns.spots: Reviewers report fading of dark spots, acne marks and post-acne scars over weeks of use, with one noting scars became less obvious within hours to days.
concerns.blemishes: The large majority of reviewers, across ages and skin types, report fewer breakouts, faster healing of active pimples and clearer skin within one to several weeks; a minority (sensitive, fragrance-reactive, or eczema-prone) report the opposite — new breakouts or worsened acne after one or few uses.
concerns.oiliness: Reviewers with oily skin report the product helps control oil and reduces shine without over-drying, and one notes it counters oiliness even in hot climates.

aspects.libelle: Glass bottle breaks or slips easily
Noticeable results within days to weeks

extraits.texte: TLDR, don't recommend for super sensitive skin, strong fragrance & caused acne after one use. I'm not the intended audience & that is totally fine! Full disclosure, I actually bought this kind of on accident (I'm still working on educating myself about skincare ingredients and got my acids mixed up, I'm so sorry skincare goddesses). I actually don't have very bad acne and only get like one or two pimples every few months. My skin is super sensitive, combo but mostly dry, I've had eczema my whole life, and basically anything can upset my skin (I now know I am not the intended audience for this product, only posting in case it might save somebody else time/money). This stuff has a pretty strong scent, I noticed it when I opened up the bottle and like a fool still put it on my skin despite knowing that I don't tend to react well to anything with a strong fragrance. I haven't used a ton of salicylic acid products in my life, so I'm not sure if it's the salicylic acid being too harsh on my skin or the fragrance, but after using this only once I woke up with acne after not having any for months. I don't feel that one use was enough to begin a purge. Basically just beware if you have skin that will freak out if you look at it the wrong way. And if it works for you and you love it, do your thing!

extraits.titre: Seems to work well for sensitive skin
extraits.texte: This is my third bottle now. After struggling with years from stress-related acne, I've boiled my skincare routine down to a gentle cleanser, moisturizer, spf and this serum + the occasional pimple sticker to deal with active pimples. I have pretty sensitive and reactive skin. The combination of living in a humid country, traveling a lot and having a stressful lifestyle has taken a hit to my skin. I appreciate having this non-scented serum to apply before my moisturizer and spf during the day time. It helps me feel like I can have my breakouts under control. It feels like it does help my recovering acne and has improved my skin barrier/quality and texture of my skin.

Love! I have definitely noticed improvement in my skin tone and breakouts. A little goes a long way. The smell isn't the greatest but it's not bad! I can feel it working on my skin as soon as I apply it! My skin is typically oily but dries out easily with acne products. This has not made me overly dry. I would buy again!!

My skin is very reactive and dry making treating acne difficult. After one use my acne is visibly reduced. My skin looks much more even and glowing. Excited to see results after using it for a little.
